name: runtime-sop
description: Local-first Chrome workflow recorder and shared SOP reader

scripts.build: node tools/build-example.cjs && node tools/build-dashboard.cjs && node tools/build-relationships.cjs && node tools/build-mobile-reader.cjs && node tools/build-storage-pages.cjs && node tools/scan-public.cjs && node tools/package.cjs
scripts.test:release-browser: node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/public-browser.cjs tests/folder-browser.cjs tests/qr-browser.cjs tests/dashboard-language-browser.cjs tests/relationships-browser.cjs tests/workspace-relations-browser.cjs tests/storage-pages-browser.cjs tests/appearance-browser.cjs tests/relationships-connected-browser.cjs tests/unified-overview-browser.cjs
scripts.test:team-browser: node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/team-workspace-browser.cjs tests/team-library-browser.cjs tests/team-service-picker-browser.cjs tests/team-read-view-browser.cjs tests/team-library-images-browser.cjs tests/team-sidebar-images-browser.cjs tests/team-slow-publish-browser.cjs
scripts.build:release: npm run build && npm run build:team-service && npm run build:release-media && node tools/release-checksums.cjs
scripts.test:history-browser: node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/library-history-browser.cjs tests/options-categories-browser.cjs tests/library-categories-browser.cjs tests/library-recovery-browser.cjs tests/workspace-history-browser.cjs
scripts.test:interaction-browser: node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/annotation-editing-browser.cjs tests/step-feedback-browser.cjs tests/publish-reading-browser.cjs tests/mosaic-editing-browser.cjs tests/mosaic-publication-browser.cjs
